integrity: The mathematical statement is based on explicit resolvent/transport identities and max-flow/min-cut, with rational reproducibility checks. Standard transportation theorems and prior forward delegation and inverse PageRank work are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive retention fractions, finite trust digraph, uniform one-vote initial masses, nonnegative fractions with some allowed edges permitted to carry zero. A nonmajority ceiling requires equal retention. No assertion of strategic equilibrium, pivotal voting power, independent proof audit, or exhaustive publication priority.
title: Exact inverse feasibility and a sharp concentration ceiling for fractional delegation
